role: rights-reviewed rhythm reserve; NOT fitted or admitted to melody training

rights_review.encoding_and_performance: Official creator/licensor directly distributes this named dataset under CC BY 4.0. This is stronger evidence than a third-party scraped collection label. Official page describes commissioned professional drummers and additional contributors performing improvised beats and fills. No external song transcription is asserted.
rights_review.composition_and_patterns: Improvised drum performances and ten deliberately shared evaluation beat patterns are the declared source. Preserve repeat-pattern relationships; recording count is not independent composition count. The official dataset-wide grant is relied on for this scoped research, not a claim of worldwide public domain.
rights_review.arrangement: No historical-score edition or third-party melody arrangement imported; retained performer variation is part of the licensed MIDI.
rights_review.audio: MIDI-only archive acquired. No sampled or rendered audio, samplebank, or audio rights relied on.
rights_review.notices: No warranties or endorsement. Moral/privacy and other unlicensed rights are not waived by our interpretation. Do not infer individual anonymized performer identities.
rights_review.scope: Private storage and read-only audit allowed under owner research authorization; a rhythm model remains prospective, and no public release authorized.

attribution.title: Groove MIDI Dataset
attribution.credit: Google LLC; dataset contributors acknowledged on the source page
attribution.citation: Jon Gillick, Adam Roberts, Jesse Engel, Douglas Eck, and David Bamman. Learning to Groove with Inverse Sequence Transformations. ICML, 2019.
attribution.changes: Official ZIP and its MIDI bytes unmodified. Google reports merged tracks and all MIDI messages set to channel 9 before distribution. Audit metadata is newly derived; originals remain intact.
attribution.conditions: Retain supplied credits, copyright/license/disclaimer notices and source/license links; indicate modifications; no added legal/technical restrictions, no endorsement implication.

license_evidence_access: Direct HTTP deed fetch returned403. Deed and complete English legal code were successfully read through web connector; no file hash is claimed for those connector-rendered pages. Official dataset page was downloaded and hashed.
planned_gates: Rhythm-specific timing/instrument semantics and near-duplicate review before fitting
limits: MIDI drum key numbers must never enter the pitched melody model as pitches.
Official genre labels are performer-provided source labels, not our subjective musical appeal judgments.
Original train/validation/test labels do not prove unseen performer or unseen pattern generalization.

archive_license_notice.evidence: The original MIDI-only archive itself explicitly licenses this work under CC BY 4.0; agrees with official creator page.

independent_review: Second research worker checked dataset-wide license and source assertions against downloaded official page. No substantive blocker found for scoped rhythm reserve; no broader song-independence claim.
